patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with high-contrast alternating dark and light backgrounds, creating distinct visual breaks and emphasizing content.
Prominent, large, and bold sans-serif headings are consistently paired with smaller, lighter body text and tiny, uppercase labels for contextual information.
A stark monochrome palette of black, white, and dark gray dominates, creating a sophisticated and minimal aesthetic with very limited use of accent colors.
Background images and videos in hero-like sections exhibit a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground text and elements.
New content sections are revealed with a smooth slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
Key product imagery and video are integrated as immersive, full-bleed backgrounds or central, large-scale elements within sections, often with minimal text overlays.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling library (locomotive-scroll) to create a fluid and continuous scroll experience across the entire page.
Hero and prominent product sections utilize full-bleed video or high-resolution photography backgrounds, often with a subtle dark overlay to ensure optimal text legibility.
Scroll-triggered animations (likely via locomotive-scroll) reveal new content sections by sliding them up from the bottom of the viewport with a gentle ease-in effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, lighter body text and tiny, uppercase labels for context.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (2-4px) on buttons and some interactive elements, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of openness and focus on individual elements.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, high-quality product photography and video as immersive backgrounds, combined with sophisticated scroll-triggered animations and a minimalist aesthetic, creates a highly engaging and premium brand experience. The physical product is consistently the hero, presented with a sense of gravitas and modern elegance.
